fee_details:
- Joining fee: Rs. 500
- Annual fee: Rs. 500 (2nd year onwards)
- Add-on card annual fee: Nil
- Card replacement fee: Nil
- Cheque return or dishonour fee: 2% of the payment amount subject to a minimum of Rs. 500, Max. Rs.1500
- Charge slip retrieval fee or copy request fee: Waived
- Cash withdrawal fee: 2.5% of the cash amount; Minimum of Rs. 500
- Overdue cheque fee: Waived
- Overlimit penalty: 2.5% of the limit; Min. amount of Rs. 500
- Add-on card joining fee: Nil
- Late payment fee: If the total payment due is less than Rs. 5000: Nil; Payment between Rs.5001 and Rs.10000: Rs.500; Payment between Rs.10001 and Rs. 20000: Rs.750; If the total payment due is greater than Rs.10,000: Rs.1200
- Duplicate statement fee: Waived
- Cash payment fee: Rs. 100
- GST: As per Government rules
- Finance charges: 3.6% per month (324% per annum)
- Hot listing fee: Nil
- Surcharge on purchase of railway tickets: As per IRCTC
- Balance enquiry charges: Waived
- Foreign Currency Transaction fee: 3.5% of the transaction value
joining_perks:
- Welcome benefit of Rs. 500 and wide range of discounts on other purchases.
- 5% cashback on your purchases at Flipkart and Cleartrip
- 5% cashback on purchases made from preferred merchants
reward_structure:
- Avail a voucher of Rs.500 on Flipkart on your first transaction.
- On your first Myntra order, get 50% instant discount up to Rs.300.
With effect from April 10, 2024, above cashback will be offered for all transactions made with the Flipkart AXIS BANK Credit Card, excluding those made on Flipkart, preferred merchants, and card-linked categories.
key_highlights:
- Rs.500 welcome benefit
- 5% cashback on Flipkart and Cleartrip
- 20% discount for new customers on Urban Clap, up to Rs.400 with your credit card

benefits_features.Travel benefits:
The domestic airport lounge benefits on your Flipkart AXIS BANK Credit Card will be updated as follows:
- Lounge access will be determined based on the total amount spent using your Flipkart AXIS BANK Credit Card over the previous 3 calendar months.
- Starting from 1st May 2024, a minimum spending requirement will be implemented to access complimentary lounges.
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Avail a fuel surcharge waiver of 1% with your credit card at all petrol pumps across India.
benefits_features.Dining benefits: With your Flipkart Axis Bank credit card, get a discount at 20+ partner restaurants under the "Dining Delights" program in many cities.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: The joining fee for the card is Rs.500, and the annual fee for the card is also Rs.500; however, the annual fee will be deducted from the 2nd year onwards.
benefits_features.Lounge benefits: You can enjoy up to 2 complimentary domestic airport access annually using your Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card.

how_tos.How to Apply for the Flipkart Axis Bank: You have the option to apply online or offline for the Axis Bank credit card. You can apply for the card offline by going to an Axis Bank branch or by getting in touch with customer service.
how_tos.How can I add an add-on credit card for: No, you can only add an add-on credit card for your Husband, Wife, Daughter, Son (if they are aged 18 and above), Parents and Siblings.
how_tos.Can my Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card be: No, you cannot transfer the ownership of the credit card to someone else.
how_tos.How soon will I receive the physical car: After your application is approved, you will receive your card to your registered address within 7 working days.
how_tos.How can I find out the status of my appl: You can get in touch with customer service or use the bank's website to find out the status of your Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card. You can view the application status by providing your mobile number or using your application PAN number.

reward_point_benefits: No reward points are offered on this card.

miscellaneous:
Eligibility Criteria for Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card:
The eligibility criteria to apply for Axis Bank Flipkart credit cards are mentioned below:
- The age of the add-on credit cardholder must be 18 years or above.
- The cardholder must be a resident or a non-resident of India.
- The age of the primary credit cardholder must be between 18 and 70 years.

faqs.What is the Flipkart Credit Card from Ax: Axis Bank has an association with Flipkart (Flipkart Pvt. Ltd.) and Myntra, and issues a co-branded Flipkart Axis Bank credit card to the consumer. Consumers can use the Card for any kind of purchase, both online and offline, and will receive limitless supply of cashback, which will be credited to their linked account.
faqs.Are the reward points earned on the Flip: No, the Axis Bank credit card for Flipkart does not come with any reward points. At the conclusion of the statement cycle, the credit card provider provides cashback on a specific portion of your transactions.
faqs.How can I know how much cashback I've ea: The cashback on the Flipkart Axis Bank credit card will be shown in the cashback earned section. You may examine the total cashback earned monthly on the credit card statement on the Axis Bank website and select Flipkart Axis Bank credit card. You may also track the cashback for orders planned on a daily basis using the "Order Summary Page" and then sending it to the "Transaction Summary" version.
